puzzleText:
A confidential informant is trying to organise a clandestine rendezvous with you.

He has sent a cryptic postcard.

From the picture on the front of the card, you can deduce that the meeting place is Central Station.

But what time will your contact be there?

On the back of the card you find these symbols:
[[ASCII]]

                                                    
         _                       _     ___        
   __   | |_|   • •   |_|_|   |_| |    _|_|   |_|_| 
   ↺     ↻      ↺      ↺      ↻       ↺     ↻↻
   
[[/ASCII]]
Can you solve the puzzle and figure out when he'll be there?
hint: The answer will be a time in digital clock format. Use the arrows to turn the numbers and symbols the right way up.
title: Rendevouz at Central Station
